namespace BddAbove186
universe u v w
variable {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {γ : Type w} [LE γ]
variable {f : α → β → γ} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {c : γ}
theorem image2_bound (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, f x y ≤ c) :
    BddAbove (Set.image2 f s t) :=
  ⟨c, Set.forall_mem_image2.mpr h⟩
theorem image2_bound_iff : BddAbove (Set.image2 f s t) ↔
    ∃ c, ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, f x y ≤ c := by
  simp only [bddAbove_def, Set.forall_mem_image2]
#print axioms image2_bound
#print axioms image2_bound_iff
#check @Set.forall_mem_image2
#check @bddAbove_def
#check @BddAbove.image2
end BddAbove186
